responsibility: Main target-definition header for the NVPTX port. It declares the compile-time target macros that describe ABI, data layout, register set, calling convention scaffolding, machine_function state, assembler syntax, builtins exposure, and default driver specs, and it ties in generated architecture predicates from nvptx-gen.h plus option enums from nvptx-opts.h so the rest of GCC can compile against the NVPTX target model.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem nvptx files, this is the target definition header consumed at compile time: it declares macros, register/ABI layout, machine_function, and includes generated option/predicate headers, whereas nvptx.cc implements the hooks, nvptx.md describes instruction patterns, and nvptx.opt declares backend options.
